_freeze_source: docs/decisions/pilot_freeze_2026-08-18.md for P-003 through P-007, unchanged. The one new value, corpus_record_budget, is DECISIONS.md P-011 with its derivation in _corpus_record_budget_note below.
_freeze_provenance: Frozen 2026-08-19 at the project owner's direction. Identical to primary_pilot.json in every scientific value except the addition of corpus_record_budget. The 2026-08-18 execution of primary_pilot.json is retained unaltered at results/runs/primary_pilot_2026-08-18/; this config does not supersede that record, it succeeds it.
_supersedes: configs/experiment/primary_pilot.json, whose execution failed PROTOCOL.md section 4 on both axes: FAILURE_LOG.md F-020 (human, 10.1% on one arm) and F-021 (total, 2.26% across arms).
_what_changed: One field. Rescued human examples now displace synthetic records instead of being appended, so realised total optimizer tokens are equal across arms by construction rather than by measurement. F-020's cause is fixed in code (policies/terminal.py) and needs no config change.
_warning: Executable. Every value below is fixed before any chain runs. Changing one after a chain has run invalidates budget matching; add a new config instead.
_condition: primary pilot v2: the frozen horizon, budget, total-token match, ordered seeds, outcomes, contrast, and exclusions shared by the no_rescue, random, schedule_only, selection_only, and joint arms, under displacement assembly.
_arms: Five conditions. PROTOCOL.md section 4 names six treatment families; the sixth, an oracle upper bound, is not implemented and is deliberately absent rather than approximated. Its absence bounds what the comparison can claim.

no_rescue.note: No config file. NoRescuePolicy takes no parameters by design: it ignores budget and candidates so the control arm cannot begin spending if a budget field changes.

_budget_units: Optimizer tokens under the frozen GPT-2 tokenizer, per DECISIONS.md P-002 and FAILURE_LOG.md F-010b. NOT whitespace word counts.
_total_optimizer_tokens_note: A projection, not a spendable budget (DECISIONS.md P-009). The 2026-08-18 run measured 16,678,912 on the arm that spends nothing, so this figure is 3.6% low and P-010 records it as superseded by measurement. It is left unchanged here so the two configs differ in exactly one field; the validator treats it as a projection with a band, not as an assertion.
_corpus_record_budget_note: DECISIONS.md P-011. Each generation's assembled training corpus holds exactly this many records: rescued human examples displace synthetic ones rather than adding to them. Derivation, not a chosen round number: the prompt corpus is built with --limit 400 (docs/RUNBOOK_PILOT_LAUNCH.md step 4) and upstream generate.py emits one continuation per prompt, so every generation's decode produces 400 synthetic records. Setting the budget to that size keeps the corpus exactly the size the decode produces and lets human data take places within it. Under the additive assembly this replaces, the corpus was 400 plus however many examples the policy bought, which is precisely how training volume came to track spend (F-021).

data._subsample_note: First 400 articles in frozen manifest order. Deterministic because the manifest is.

primary_contrast: joint minus the strongest eligible non-joint baseline, where eligibility is fixed by PREREGISTRATION.md and may not be chosen using primary treatment outcomes
_exclusion_rules: Verbatim from PREREGISTRATION.md 'Exclusions'. Divergence, harmful performance, null performance and negligible effects are scientific outcomes, not exclusions.
exclusion_rules: a corrupt or missing required artifact
a verified wrong frozen config or code commit
verified data leakage or manifest mismatch
infrastructure termination before a required checkpoint
_minimum_chains_note: Five paired chains per arm, the frozen primary seed set. The 2026-08-18 run measured between-chain variance at 0.41-1.08% CV against a 2% threshold, which docs/decisions/powered_design_sizing_2026-08-19.md shows is already powered at that threshold. This run is therefore a powered test, not only a variance estimate -- provided both fairness axes hold, which is what this config exists to secure.
